dashboard.intro: One dependency-free interface shared by the browser and native hosts.

overview.nativeBody: Accessible components with no framework lock-in.
overview.themeBody: Change the visual system through a compact set of variables.

bridge.title: Call native code
bridge.body: The same promise-based API works with Python, C#, and browser mocks.

components.title: Small pieces, composed freely.
components.tokensBody: Colors, spacing, type, radius, motion, and elevation are all customizable.

charts.title: Thousands of points, continuously updated.
charts.body: Canvas rendering, bounded memory, and peak-preserving downsampling keep updates fluid.

toasts.title: Toast notifications
toasts.body: Queued, accessible, actionable, and automatically dismissed.
toasts.infoMessage: A background task has new information.
toasts.warningMessage: This operation may need your attention.
toasts.errorMessage: The operation could not be completed.
